description: This file defines a template-based Factory class within the Thunder::Core namespace, providing mechanisms for creating, managing, and iterating over factory objects that produce and handle base objects identified by unique identifiers. It includes internal classes for factory instances and an iterator for traversing registered factories.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of factory instances that produce objects of type BASEOBJECT, identified by a key of type IDENTIFIER. It supports creation, destruction, and iteration over factories, as well as object retrieval.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the registered factories within FactoryType, providing methods to check validity, move to next, and access factory details.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory instances managed by the FactoryType object.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory identified by the given identifier.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates and registers a new factory for a specific element type, with an optional initial queue size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to an object of type ACTUALELEMENT associated with the given identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the base object associated with the specified identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all registered factories.
